# PsyDx

> AI-assisted mental wellness, psychology learning, clinical support, and therapist ecosystem.

PsyDx is a mental health technology platform combining a DSM-5-TR learning engine for students and clinicians, a wellness toolkit for clients, and an AI assistant with safety guardrails. It does not provide diagnoses or replace licensed clinicians.

- [Home](/): Product overview and feature highlights
- [Crisis resources](/crisis): International crisis hotlines and immediate support
